chamDesc:
Which way will you look?
A quick test of your reflexes!
circleDesc:
Draw with your fingertip.
Find your perfect circle!
shootDesc:
Aim with your hand.
Pinch to pop!
handMenuHint: Move your hand over the button, then pinch to start!
hint: Hit the targets as they appear. Keep a streak for bonus points!
readyDesc: Hit as many targets as you can in 30 seconds.
readyDetail: Miss a shot, lose a life. You have 5 lives!
resultEmptySub: Finish your first game to see your results!
localNote: Records are saved in this browser.
privacy: Video stays on your device. It is never saved or uploaded.
notFound: This game is still getting ready.
recordError: Browser storage is unavailable. This result could not be saved.
cameraErrorHelp: Check your browser permissions and camera, then try again.
permissionHint: Allow camera access in your browser.
visionError: Tracking is resting. You can use the mouse!
showHand: Show an open hand to the camera!
faceError: Face tracking is unavailable. Retry or use buttons.
handReady: Show an open hand to get ready!
handPaused: Hand out of view. Taking a pause!
handHelp: Open your hand to aim. Pinch to pop!
futureRpsDesc:
Show your hand.
Make your move!
futureDodgeDesc:
Dodge the obstacles.
Stay in the game!
futurePoseDesc:
See the pose?
Make it your own!
circleHandHint: Pinch thumb and index to draw · Release to stop
circleInstruction:
Follow the dotted line with your fingertip
or mouse and close the circle!
circleTargetHint: Bring the first and last points together.
circleStageHint: Take your time. Keep the line moving!
circleFooterHint: Connect one full loop to close the line
circleReadyDesc: Complete the prettiest circle you can in 20 seconds.
circleHandReady: Position the green cursor, then pinch your thumb and index finger to draw. Release to stop. Press Finish drawing to score.
circleMouseReady: Place your mouse on the canvas to start!
circleHint:
Start with a wide loop,
then return to your starting point.
circleEvaluation: Roundness and closure are scored together
circleEvaluationHint: The closer the line closes, the higher the score!
circleResultSub: Your very own circle, drawn by hand!
rpsDesc:
Show your hand
and challenge the computer!
rpsInstructions: Scissors: two fingers. Rock: a fist. Paper: an open palm. Show your hand within 3 seconds after the countdown.
rpsHold: Face your palm toward the camera and hold the shape briefly!
rpsKeyHint: Buttons or keys: 1 Rock · 2 Paper · 3 Scissors
dodgeDesc:
Move your body left and right
to dodge falling stars!
showBody: Stand where both shoulders are visible.
dodgeInstructions: Move left and right to dodge falling stars. Survive for 30 seconds!
dodgeCenter: Stand comfortably in the middle. Start sets your current position as center.
dodgeRules: 3 lives · 10 points per second · 50 per dodged star. Stars get faster over time!
dodgeMove: Move your body left and right!
dodgeKeyHint: Hold ← → / A D or a button to move
dodgeRetryNote: Take a breather and try again!
touchAim: Tap a target with your finger
touchCircle: Keep your finger down to draw a circle.
touchDodge: Hold an arrow button to move
